summary: Mission 52: two fallen rock climbers evacuated from 500 vertical feet of boulder field strewn with downed trees west of Empire; significant injuries, extreme heat; lengthy technical carryout
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Clear Creek Sheriff's Department, Clear Creek EMS, Clear Creek Fire Authority, Gilpin Ambulance Authority, Jeffcom 911
notes: One rescuer's 430th mission; both climbers expected to recover; posted 2025-06-22
